subject: Transportation Demand Management Program
overview: City Councilor Matt Leming outlined a proposal to incorporate a Transportation Demand Management program into Medford's zoning recodification. The initiative aims to address traffic congestion by offering developers administrative zoning variances in exchange for transit mitigation credits.

items.title: Transportation Demand Management Presentation
items.summary: City Councilor Matt Leming detailed how a proposed Transportation Demand Management program would mitigate local traffic congestion by streamlining zoning variances for developers who invest in alternative transit infrastructure.
